title: Chhaya hex cell
description: One H3 cell over Delhi. Every row in cells.parquet and every Feature in cells.geojson must match this shape.

ndvi.description: Mean NDVI for the cell from Sentinel-2. Null if cloud-covered.

lst_c.description: Mean land surface temperature in Celsius from Landsat thermal. Null if Landsat unavailable.

population.description: WorldPop population sum for the cell.

built_frac.description: Fraction of cell covered by buildings.

school_count.description: Number of schools in the cell (OSM amenity=school).

ward.description: Ward name for aggregation. Null until wards.geojson is added.

priority.description: Weighted priority score. Higher = more urgent for intervention.
